_doc: Today's read budgets (2026-11-15). Window reads only (origin=window). steadyP95Ms: p95 of reads more than launchWindowMs after start; Today reads saved snapshots, so 100 ms. launchMaxMs: the slowest read in the launch window. minSamples: fewer steady reads than this are judged by their maximum. Checked by today-budgets.mjs in replay.mjs (the person's log) and report.mjs (the trial).
